speaker: Martian
text: Hurt you? Why would I hurt you, stranger?

speaker: Astronaut
text: Well, the last Martian I met tried to vaporize me with a giant laser!

speaker: Martian
text: Ah, that must have been Gnorp. He's... going through a phase. I'm Zorblax, a peaceful researcher. A humble martian as you call us...

speaker: Astronaut
text: Whew... That's a relief. I'm an astronaut from Earth.

speaker: Martian
text: Welcome to Mars, Earthling! Well the planet YOU call Mars... Do not worry, not all of us shoot first.
